name: MonarchMarketingSection
title: Marketing sections
wrapsNative: VStack sections; Grid and GridRow for MonarchFeatureGrid; DisclosureGroup with .disclosureGroupStyle(.monarch) for MonarchFaq; MonarchFlowLayout for MonarchStatStrip and the actions of MonarchCtaBand
summary: The body blocks of a product's about, welcome or upgrade screen: a section with an eyebrow, title and description (MonarchMarketingSection, MonarchMarketingSectionHeader), feature cards (MonarchFeatureGrid), a framed picture of the product (MonarchProductFrame), figures (MonarchStatStrip), questions (MonarchFaq) and a closing call to action (MonarchCtaBand).
whenToUse: On a screen inside an app that explains the product or a plan: what it does, its main features, common questions and what to do next.
whenNotToUse: For settings, use a Form with sections. For help articles, use a List of links to the help centre. For a single empty state, use MonarchEmptyState.

states.name: section
states.description: Header, then 32 points, then the content.

states.name: feature grid
states.description: Bordered cards in equal columns, rows as tall as their tallest card.

states.name: product frame
states.description: A clipped, bordered window around the content, with an optional browser bar.

states.name: stat strip
states.description: Values in the title role with their labels under them, wrapping onto further rows.

states.name: FAQ
states.description: Questions separated by dividers; each opens its answer under it.

states.name: CTA band
states.description: A title, an optional sentence and the actions on the subtle background.

appearance: Eyebrows use the accent's strong colour, titles the default text colour, descriptions and stat labels the muted text colour. Cards and frames sit on the surface colour with the subtle border; the CTA band and the browser bar use the subtle background. Colours come from theme roles in every theme.
platformNotes: On the web these blocks build public marketing pages, with a page heading level, section bands with tones and spacing presets, and a product frame that can show a browser or device bar. On iOS they are views for an about, welcome or upgrade screen inside the app's scroll view: the section draws no band of its own (the screen keeps its background), MonarchFaq uses the standard DisclosureGroup with the Monarch style, and MonarchProductFrame draws the browser bar only; use MonarchDeviceFrame for a phone or tablet. Android does not ship these blocks.
accessibility: Section titles, feature titles and the CTA title have the header trait.
Each feature card is one element, read as its title and description.
Each stat is one element, read as its value and its label.
Each FAQ question is a disclosure button read with "Expanded" or "Collapsed"; its answer follows it.
A product frame is one image element named by its label; the picture inside is not read.
At the accessibility text sizes feature cards stack in one column.
edgeCases: A feature grid with an odd number of cards leaves the last row's trailing cells empty.
Long stat values wrap; keep values short.
A product frame clips content that is larger than its frame.
